### 4.6c Chase and flight: an exploratory interpretation of the social gradients

#### The shape has a name — held now as hypothesis, not finding
proposed: Move the whole subsection to §7, immediately before §7.5 “The measure against the market's measure.”
rationale: The subsection explicitly labels itself an exploratory interpretation and develops a sociolinguistic mechanism rather than reporting the core estimates. Moving it to Discussion restores the Results/interpretation boundary and makes §4 proceed from covariates to permeation without a long theoretical interruption.
